title: Workflow export snapshot or import payload
$comment: Two shapes: workflowExportSnapshot matches persisted exportWorkflow output; workflowImportPayload is the minimal JSON importWorkflow accepts for new workflow roots (e.g. LLM-generated). Milestone fields marked export-only are ignored on import.
description: Menuyukti workflow (milestone tree) as JSON. (1) Export snapshot: written by exportWorkflow with DB ids and timestamps; use for backup and round-trip after re-import (ids are reassigned). (2) Import payload: only workflowName and milestones are required; goal is optional. importWorkflow ignores schemaVersion, workflowId, exportedAt, milestone id, milestone status, and passCriteria id. Omit result when creating a fresh workflow unless you need a prefilled evaluation summary.

examples.goal: Increase weekday lunch covers using Instagram promos tied to top sellers.

milestones.title: Define audience and offer
milestones.goal: Agree on target guest and single primary offer.

workflowExportSnapshot.description: Full snapshot from exportWorkflow: includes format version, root workflow node id, and export timestamp. Re-import assigns new database ids; these metadata fields are not read by importWorkflow.

schemaVersion.description: Payload format version. Export-only; importWorkflow does not validate this.

workflowId.description: Root workflow container node id at export time (node_type workflow in DB). Export-only; new root receives a new id on import.

goal.description: Workflow-level objective from root node data.goal. On import, stored on the new root when string; null means no goal field.

exportedAt.description: UTC ISO-8601 when the export was written. Export-only; not used on import.

milestones.description: Milestone nodes under the workflow root, ordered by order then legacy id for tie-break (export).

workflowImportPayload.description: Minimal payload accepted by importWorkflow: non-empty workflowName and a milestones array. Optional root goal; milestone ids and export-only fields may be omitted.

workflowName.description: Name for the new root node (whitespace-stripped; empty after trim is rejected by the API).

goal.description: Optional high-level workflow objective. Omit or null for no goal on the root node.

milestones.description: Milestones to create under the root, processed in sorted order by order then id tie-break. May be empty.

milestoneNode.description: Milestone: title and order define the node; pass criteria, goal child, markdown data, and optional result are created from these fields on import.

id.description: Milestone node id from the database in exports. Export-only; not persisted on import (use any placeholder such as "0" in tools that require a string). Used only as a secondary sort key when order ties.

title.description: Milestone display name. Defaults to "Milestone" on import if missing or blank.

order.description: Display sequence (non-negative). Primary sort key for milestones on import.

goal.description: Milestone-level goal text; creates a goal child node when non-empty after trim.

dataTask.description: manual: user supplies milestone markdown (data). Other values: milestone Data uses the corresponding prepare pipeline in agent_skills (see apps/web milestone dataTask enum).

data.description: Markdown body stored on the milestonedata child when non-empty; prefilled context for the milestone.

status.description: Derived rail status from pass criteria and result in exports (complete / failed / pending / empty). Export-only; ignored on import.

passCriteria.description: Checklist rows; each valid row creates a passcriteria child. Omit or use [] when there are no criteria.

result.description: Optional evaluation summary child. Omit for new workflows; include when replaying a saved evaluation outcome.

passCriteriaExport.description: One pass/fail row; maps to a passcriteria child on import (id not stored).

id.description: passcriteria node id in exports. Export-only; not used on import.

status.description: open: not yet evaluated; pass / fail: evaluation outcome.

resultExport.description: Milestone evaluation rollup; creates a result child when summary, passed, and total are present with correct types.

summary.description: Short narrative of how criteria were judged.

criteria.description: Per-criterion detail from automated evaluation (aligned with result node validation and milestone eval output).

id.description: Stable id for the passcriteria row (often mirrors passcriteria node id).

status.description: Evaluation outcome for this row (e.g. pass, fail).
